items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And it was Wesley Helvey. He said, "You know, Quentin," he said, "how would you like to join my band?" I told him I'd love to.

ctx.x: And I was singing, too, so he told me, he said, "You know, Quentin," he said, "you got a good chance to make it in music." He said, "I'm going to Cincinnati and if I see anybody out there that wants a trombone player, I'll tell him about you because I think you got a good chance." So he went to Helvey's Troubadours in Cincinnati.

So I had left Elmer [Burns] and I was working for the big undertaker at that time, Patterson. So I'm sitting there one night to answer the telephone in case any calls come in and I get this call from Cincinnati. I said, "Who in the devil knows me in Cincinnati?" And it was Wesley Helvey. He said, "You know, Quentin," he said, "how would you like to join my band?" I told him I'd love to.
